## Appearance

Dora is characterized by a neat and proper appearance, featuring a straight nose, a "prunes and prisms" mouth, and gentle, mild hazel eyes. She wears her hair in long, sleek curls that never get out of order. Her attire includes a nicely starched white dress accented with a black sash.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044)_

## Personality

Dora is a quiet, lovely, and well-behaved child who is often seen as a model of proper behavior. Characterized by a prim and demure manner, she speaks when spoken to and remains composed even in tense situations. She is exceptionally neat, faithful, and industrious, taking joy in helping with small tasks suited to her hands. In her learning and chores, she works carefully, systematically, and dispassionately, reciting her lessons meekly like a machine. Considered placid, sensible, and unusually careful for her age, her predictable nature has been likened to a book where every page is identical. As she grows, she maintains her quiet disposition and develops into a womanly and helpful individual.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P88](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0088), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), +10 more_

## History

Dora Keith moved to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with her twin brother [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), though she was soon pushed into a pigpen by him and later locked in a toolhouse as part of one of his pranks. Her stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) became permanent after her uncle, [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md), died and left money in trust for the twins. While attending school, Dora was once frightened by a classmate's stories about a ghost relative, and on another occasion, she was coerced by [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) into skipping [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school) to go fishing. Over time, she continued living at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) alongside [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Lynde, and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), joining them in welcoming [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back for visits and eventually celebrating [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Gilbert's wedding.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P9](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0009), +26 more_

## Relationships

### [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--dora.md)

[Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) is Dora's brother, and the two are brought to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) together. Dora is frequently on the receiving end of Davy's unruly behavior, such as when he causes her to fall into a pigpen. On another occasion, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) hides Dora in a toolhouse and lies about her disappearance, causing the household to panic until she is found.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), +20 more_

- Sibling of — brother  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), +12 more</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--dora.md)

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helps care for Dora at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and teaches at her school, where she deals with Dora being frightened by a classmate's ghost stories. Dora acts as a friend to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), affectionately welcoming her whenever she returns home.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +2 more_

- Friend of — welcoming her affectionately on her return home (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Again P14](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0014)</sub>
